item.description: Sameek was one of the first persons to use Unreal Engine, ever since it came out in March 2014, and he has extensive knowledge on the engine, from C++ gameplay programming, to editor scripting , UI and Slate, Niagara VFX , Materials and Shaders, he is known to work on a variety of stunning projects and he has been developing contents for the marketplace since 2015.
